name: Pinboard
summary: A shared board of notes that knows who pinned what.
description:
Each Pinboard grain is its own board. Share it with a link: editors can pin notes, viewers can only read, and the owner can tidy up anything.

A Hamstr demo app: it never asks anyone to log in. The platform tells it who is visiting (X-Hamstr-Username) and what they may do (X-Hamstr-Permissions).

permissions.title: Pin notes
permissions.description: Add notes and remove your own.

roles.title: Can pin
roles.description: Read the board and pin notes.
